description:
Overview

Job Title: AI Engineer (Search Engine)

About the Company: Insight Global's Client

Type: 10 month extending contract

Compensation: Shared upon initial WhatsApp screening call

Location: Fully Remote

Working Hours: 10AM - 6PM BRT (9AM-5PM EST)

Interview Process: immediate interviews available - 2 rounds can close by end of next week.

Requirements

  • Ability to work full-time hours on a contract basis (10AM - 6PM BRT)
  • Strong communication skills
  • CLT ONLY ( This cannot change to PJ)
  • No health benefits providd in CLT benefits
  • Needs to be able to start within 2-3 weeks
  • Paid on a monthly basis, no overtime

Must-Haves

  • 1+ years of experience as a Search Engineer or AI Engineer
  • Search Technology Experience – OpenSearch, building scalable search systems
  • 2+ years of Python development experience, including API creation, model training, testing, and general backend programming
  • Familiarity with LangChain for building LLM workflows using tools, memory, and retrieval
  • Strong communication skills – able to work independently while providing clear updates to the team

Nice to Have Skills

  • Familiarity with AWS infrastructure (IAM, VPC, S3, etc.)

Project Overview

We are hiring one AI / LLM Engineers (1 Mid-Level) to join a small, focused team building backend features for an existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) service. Your primary focus will be building and optimizing RAG models for search across large-scale medical and scientific documents, including pre-processing and embedding over half a billion documents to ensure they are searchable and contextually accurate. You’ll work on semantic chunking strategies, improving the automated evaluation pipeline, and fine-tuning LLMs for textual RAG use cases. The role involves hands-on experimentation, model development, and backend engineering, with deployments to non-prod environments and collaboration with DevOps for production rollout. While this is a heads-down, individual contributor role, strong communication and collaboration with the team are essential.

description:

At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 240 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.

About The Job:

As a member of the Support Team at Zyte, you will be responsible for providing customer support across all our platforms, working closely with development, sales and other technical teams to ensure our customers are receiving the best service possible.

We are big fans of Continuous Improvement and use metrics to measure and improve our processes. Whenever possible, we suggest improvements to our products and write our own internal tools in order to give the best possible service to our customers.

About you:

You are extremely well organized and self-motivated - essential because we're a remote team. You are a creative problem solver with a think-outside-the-box and can-do attitude and have a passion for great customer service.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Provide world class support for our Zyte customers by delighting them in every interaction.
  • Investigate and resolve issues keeping the customer up to date on progress.
  • Strong customer focus with a mindset for preventing future recurrence of issues and be an advocate for customers to get the best value possible.
  • Demonstrate leadership and ability to work independently to resolve complex technical issues.
  • Share ideas, issues and lessons learned with the rest of the team and the community by constantly adding to and updating our Knowledge Base and process documentation.
  • Engage with engineering teams to help resolve issues and propose new features/processes that will improve our products and our customer service.

  • Assist developers on the customer side to help troubleshoot their spider code.
  • Provide assistance to internal groups in Zyte to troubleshoot issues and make configuration changes.
  • Effectively collaborate within the team and with other teams to constantly improve the processes and tools for greater efficiency and better customer satisfaction.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of support or equivalent experience in a customer-facing role.
  • Solid understanding of Computer Networks (DNS, HTTP, TCP/IP, TLS/SSL).
  • Fundamental knowledge of web programming and standards (HTML, Javascript, APIs, REST, JSON, Mysql).
  • Basic understanding of web applications, client utilities, browserstack, headless browsers.
  • Familiarity with Linux/UNIX or Mac Terminal command-line and simple scripting.
  • Strong grasp of Python to be able to write and debug code. Prefer familiarity with additional languages such as Javascript, Typescript, Java, .net/C#, Golang.
  • Excellent verbal and written English skills and ability to articulate a complex system or problem based on the type of audience.
  • Strong team player with good analytical and technical writing skills.
  • Strong relationship building skills with a sense of collaboration.
  • Ability to multi-task and manage multiple priorities and commitments.

Benefits:

By joining the Zyte team, you will:

  • Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team.
  • Have the freedom & flexibility to work remotely.
  • Get the chance to work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools.

description:
Overview

An Amazing Career Opportunity for a Regional Sales Manager, Latin America!!

Location: Remote, Brazil (Preferably Sao Paolo)

Job ID: 38490

HID is seeking a driven and experienced Regional Sales Manager (RSM) to lead the promotion and sales of Omnikey Desktop and Embedded readers across the LAM region. As a dedicated RSM for this region, you will play a critical role in establishing HID’s presence in the region, building a foundation for growth by developing new channels, securing key partnerships, and driving the adoption of Omnikey solutions in all key verticals such as Healthcare, Enterprise, Banking, Secure Printing, and EV Charging.

The RSM will take full ownership of channel development, go-to-market (GTM) strategy, market penetration, and the growth of HID's RFID solutions, working closely with internal teams and external partners to ensure that the Omnikey product line achieves maximum visibility and success in the LAM market.

The ideal candidate will develop and manage the regional sales strategy, build and maintain relationships with distributors and resellers, and ensure a structured sales process to maximize revenue. A deep understanding of the Latin American market, business culture, and distribution channels is essential. The role requires bilingual proficiency in English and Portuguese (Spanish is a plus).

Who are we?

HID powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places, and things, allowing people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely. We are a high-tech software company headquartered in Austin, TX, with over 4,500 worldwide employees. Check us out here: and

Are you ready to make a difference? Join us and help shape the future of security.

As our Regional Sales Manager, you’ll support HID’s success by:

  • Channel and Partner Management: Establishing, managing, and maintaining a robust channel network by identifying, onboarding, and training new distributors, resellers, and system integrators. Build strong relationships with channel partners to maximize product availability, market reach, and overall performance.
  • Territory Management: Traveling regularly throughout the assigned territory to nurture existing customer relationships, cultivate new partnerships, and explore untapped business opportunities.
  • Sales Strategy & Market Development: Leading the development and execution of the sales strategy for Omnikey Desktop and Embedded readers in all areas with an emphasis in key verticals such as Healthcare, Enterprise, Banking, Secure Printing, and EV Charging.
  • Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy: Defining and executing the GTM strategy for Omnikey readers in the LAM region. Working with marketing and product management teams to ensure that messaging, positioning, and sales tools align with the region’s unique market demands.
  • Business Development: Identifying and pursuing new business opportunities within target verticals. Creating comprehensive account plans to drive new revenue and expand existing accounts.
  • Customer Engagement: Engaging with end-users, resellers, and system integrators to promote the benefits and applications of Omnikey Desktop and Embedded solutions. Ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction through tailored solutions and ongoing support.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Working with marketing, technical, and product management teams to ensure alignment between market needs and product offerings. Providing feedback to guide product roadmaps and enhance solution offerings.
  • Industry Engagement: Representing HID Global and the Omnikey product line at industry events, conferences, and meetings to enhance market visibility and establish HID as a leader in the region.
  • Performance Reporting: Delivering detailed performance metrics and regular reports on sales progress, channel performance, and GTM effectiveness.

Your Experience and Background include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or technology preferred.
  • A minimum of 5 years of demonstrable experience in business development and/or technical sales, preferably within the technology or RFID sector, with a proven track record of sales and a solid understanding of RFID technologies and the sales process.
  • The ideal candidate has 5+ years of channel sales experience in Latin America, a strong network of partners and distributors, and a proven track record in driving revenue growth. They must excel in negotiations, sales strategy, and partner management, understand regional market trends, and be fluent in Spanish and/or Portuguese with English proficiency.
  • Previous experience in Physical or Logical access control use cases, with familiarity in Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Authentication credential technologies, as well as additional knowledge in mobile-centric digital transformation, is highly advantageous.
  • Proven ability to develop and manage a network of channel partners and integrators.
  • Experience in developing and executing strategic initiatives resulting in sales growth, particularly within the finance, healthcare, retail/point of sale, enterprise, or secure printing verticals. Understanding of end-user corporate cultures and decision-making processes in Banking, Education, and Commercial Real Estate is beneficial.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to lead presentations and establish credibility with both customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work as part of a cross-functional team. Experience working effectively across various departments, such as marketing, product development, and technical teams, to drive results.
  • Strong reasoning abilities to investigate and analyze information, draw relevant conclusions, and deal with complexity and ambiguity.

What we can offer you:

  • Competitive salary and rewards package
  • Competitive benefits and annual leave offering, allowing for work-life balance
  • A vibrant, welcoming & inclusive culture
  • Extensive career development opportunities and resources to maximize your potential
  • To be a part of a global organization that is pioneering the hardware, software and services that allow people to confidently navigate the physical and digital worlds

Why apply?

  • Empowerment: You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.

  • Integrity: You are results-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves, to feel appreciated and accepted.

HID is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce that reflects the global communities we serve. title: Senior Backend & Cloud Infra. Engineer - Python+AWS (LATAM)
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Python Cloud Engineer (LATAM) role at Lateral Group

About The Company

Lateral stands for technology excellence. We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality. Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’s the way we work:

  • We Have A Bias For Action & Results. We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results speak for themselves.
  • We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality - Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to.
  • We Care Deeply - We care about our work and about each other. Care Is A Competitive Advantage.
  • Every detail matters - Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default.
  • We Do Things Right - Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching.
  • We Keep Improving - Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.
  • We’re Obsessed With Agility - We chase momentum by adapting processes to fit problems, not the other way around.
  • We Take Ownership - Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas and the trust to execute.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Cloud Python Engineer at Lateral you will:

  • Build and maintain reliable, scalable backend systems with a focus on Python, AWS, and cloud-native infrastructure.
  • Design and implement APIs and batch processing jobs that serve real-world products.
  • Help architect and evolve cloud infrastructure (primarily on AWS) for availability, observability, and cost-efficiency.
  • Write clean, well-tested code that’s easy to understand, easy to debug, and built to last.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including ML and product to ship high-impact features and systems.
  • Automate away repetitive tasks and eliminate bottlenecks with thoughtful scripting and service design.
  • Support infrastructure-as-code efforts and deployment pipelines (Terraform, CDK, etc.).
  • Work closely with senior engineers to make thoughtful trade-offs around performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.
  • Own features from spec to production, with the autonomy and support to do great work.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for backend engineers who love building clean, reliable systems and enjoy solving real problems with real code. You’ll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in backend engineering
  • Strong proficiency in Python for building APIs, services, or batch processing jobs
  • Solid experience with AWS services (e.g. ECS, S3, RDS, SQS, Lambda, etc.)
  • Proficiency in SQL Databases (Postgres)
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, ECS, Kubernetes)
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g. Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK)
  • Strong grasp of software design principles, API development and batch job design and data processing in Python
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices
  • Comfort owning systems end-to-end: from design to deployment to monitoring
  • A quality mindset - you value clean code, good documentation, and thoughtful testing
  • Clear communication, async collaboration skills, and a proactive approach to problem-solving

Bonus points for

  • Experience with DICOM specific frameworks (PyDICOM, SimpleITK, OsiriX, OHIF, Orthanc)
  • Prior work in performance-sensitive or highly reliable systems
  • Contributions to internal tooling, observability, or deployment automation
  • Familiarity with security best practices for cloud and backend services
  • Experience working with sensitive data, such as PII or PHI, in a regulated industry (e.g., healthcare, finance)

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.
  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive. We’re a remote-first company, but you’re welcome to drop in if you’re near an office.
  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft and each other.
  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility.
  • A Culture of Excellence: High-quality work delivered sustainably with no burnout or crunch.
  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong with fresh challenges on every project.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. Skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer a well-defined hierarchy and fixed roles.
  • Distributed work and async collaboration aren’t your thing.
  • Feedback doesn’t excite you; we value continuous improvement and may provide nitpicky feedback.
  • Change makes you uncomfortable; priorities shift as we scale and mature.

However, if this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process

Our hiring process is structured as a sequence of steps. Moving forward is based on how well the previous step goes. We will always:

  • Let you know clearly what the next step is
  • Share updates and feedback wherever possible
  • Invite questions if anything feels unclear

Step 1: Express Your Interest

If this sounds like your kind of team and you’re ready to bring your craft to Lateral, we want to hear from you. Please send us:

  • Your resume
  • A short note about what excites you about this role
  • Links to your work: GitHub/Code snippets, portfolio, architecture/design docs, blog posts, or anything that shows how you think and build

Please don’t include anything sensitive or proprietary. If you’re sharing team projects, let us know what your specific contributions were. We review every application with care. If there’s a fit, we’ll reach out to schedule next steps.

Step 2: Talent Partner Conversation

Purpose: A structured discussion with our People Experience team to delve into your career trajectory, motivations, and alignment with Lateral's values.

  • In-depth questions about your past experiences and decision-making processes.
  • Exploration of your career goals and how they align with the role.
  • Discussion about our company culture, availability, compensation and other logistics
  • Motivators and demotivators.
  • Your life outside coding.

Step 3: Technical interview

Purpose: Assess your technical proficiency and problem-solving abilities.

  • Problem-solving exercises/questions that mirror tasks you'd encounter in the position.
  • Discussions around your approach, reasoning, and solutions.

Step 4: Client interviews

Purpose: Evaluate collaboration, communication, and consultation with external stakeholders.

  • Discussion around business and technical challenges from the client’s perspective.
  • Explain your approach, gather requirements, ask clarifying questions, and articulate tradeoffs.
  • Evaluation of how clearly you communicate solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Step 5: Operational interview

Purpose: Understand your approach to prioritizing, collaborating, shipping, and iterating.

  • How you prioritize and break down work.
  • How you collaborate across disciplines.
  • How you handle blockers, feedback, and iteration.

Step 6: Reference Checks

Purpose: We use references to understand patterns, strengths, and context to support you.

  • Provide 2–3 references who have worked closely with you.

Step 7: Offer

If selected, you’ll receive a comprehensive offer detailing compensation and other pertinent information. Our process is thorough and respectful, focusing on mutual fit. We encourage candidates to engage actively and view this as a two-way exploration.

Join us and let’s build something extraordinary.

Employment type : Full-time

Job function : Engineering and Information Technology

Industries : IT Services and IT Consulting

Job description

Para atuar no Grupo de Modelagem e Arquitetura de Sistemas Experimentais (MARE) do Laboratório Nacional de Luz Síncrotron (LNLS).

O MARÉ integra a Divisão de Engenharia de Linhas de Luz (DEL) do Sirius, e tem como escopo principal projetar sistemas de instrumentação científica de alto desempenho e/ou complexidade, demandando visão sistêmica, modelagem preditiva e princípios de engenharia de precisão. Os projetos desenvolvidos podem incluir demandas como, nanoposicionamento, otimização de gestão térmica, óptica, vácuo, criogenia, altas temperaturas, pressões e campos magnéticos, bem como tópicos avançados de automação e controle, como os relacionados à sistemas de biocontenção e descontaminação.

Trata-se de um grupo altamente multidisciplinar, que conta com técnicos, especialistas, engenheiros e analistas de formações diversas, integrando ferramentas de engenharia de sistemas, modelagem multifísica, desenhos 3D, e modelos matemáticos para oferecer serviços de engenharia aplicados ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos projetos de sistemas experimentais para linhas de luz dos laboratórios Sirius e Orion.

Main responsibilities

  • Elaboração de desenhos conceituais / técnicos, propostas de layouts e projetos de equipamentos de instrumentação científica / estações experimentais para as Linhas de Luz Orion/Sirius em software de modelagem 3D/2D, aplicando GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) quando necessário;
  • Gerar e gerenciar listas de materiais (BOM - Bill of Materials) e documentação técnica (Elaboração e atualização de documentação durante e após o desenvolvimento do projeto, incluindo manuais de montagem e operação, bem como esquemas pneumáticos e hidráulicos);
  • Liberação de desenhos para usinagem e acompanhamento da produção;
  • Prestar suporte técnico à fabricação, montagem e validação dos projetos desenvolvidos;
  • Garantir que todas as alterações e não conformidades sejam incorporadas e documentadas nos desenhos técnicos;
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas com clientes internos e externos, fornecedores e áreas internas (Engenharia, Compras, Produção).

Requirements and skills

  • Formação Superior Completa em Tecnólogo em Mecânica, Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Mecatrônica, ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em projetos de máquinas e equipamentos industriais;
  • Experiência com processos de fabricação (usinagem, soldagem, corte a laser/plasma, eletroerosão, tratamentos térmicos e superficiais);

Diferenciais:

We believe crypto is the future of finance, and we’re committed to making it useful by providing equal access to safe and intuitive financial products.

title: Client Experience Operations Specialist
description:
Overview

Client Experience Operations Specialist — Toptal

About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce. We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

As a member of our Toptal Service Center team, you will work closely with the Director, Client Experience, and the leadership of the Toptal Service Center to ensure we have the data, tools, and workflows needed to operate at our best. You will be responsible for extracting and analyzing data from Tableau, SQL, and Zendesk, creating clear insights and reporting packages for leadership. You will also own and optimize our support systems (Zendesk, Slack, automations), helping to streamline workflows and improve efficiency across the organization. This role is a key enabler of our team’s success, providing both the operational backbone and the analytical insights that drive better decisions.

Our ideal candidate has outstanding discipline, is highly passionate, and is eager to learn, grow, and develop. You will thrive in a fast-paced environment and strive to go above and beyond to effectively resolve clients’ and client services’ inquiries, issues, and concerns while maintaining a high level of client satisfaction. This role is perfect for someone who is passionate about using tools and data to solve problems, automate workflows, and make complex processes simple and scalable.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

  • Leverage SQL, Zendesk, and Tableau to analyze data and deliver actionable insights and reporting packages for the Customer Support leadership team.
  • Own and optimize Zendesk configuration (queues, triggers, macros, automations) and support tools such as Slack workflows and Zapier integrations to improve efficiency and reduce manual work.
  • Work collaboratively with the team’s managers and cross-functional partners (Product, Engineering, and Operations) to ensure systems and workflows align with business needs.
  • Act with a sense of ownership in identifying process gaps, recommending improvements, and implementing scalable solutions.
  • Maintain process documentation and act as a subject matter expert for tools, data extraction, and reporting practices.
  • Support ad-hoc analysis and operational projects, providing leadership with the insights needed for decision-making.
  • Assist with training and onboarding for team members on tools, workflows, and data processes.

First Week

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Become familiar with the various platforms and systems Toptal utilizes to offer timely and exceptional client support.
  • Complete customized onboarding to navigate through the organization and understand the moving parts that make up the Toptal business model.
  • Rapidly begin learning about Toptal’s history, culture, and vision, with a focus on the state of the talent industry, the Future of Work, and the core messages important to Toptal.

First Month

  • Familiarize yourself with the extensive support materials available to successfully support our clients and talent.
  • Learn the key internal and external stakeholders and how clients can best be served by the different Toptal teams during their lifecycle.
  • Have a solid understanding of the Toptal platform as it relates to clients and the most frequent request processes.
  • Effectively and independently resolve client issues.
  • Gain a comprehensive working knowledge of the client experience from start to finish.

First Three Months

  • Confidently onboard to our support organization, tools, and workflows.
  • Build strong working relationships with the Director and Support Managers.
  • Be comfortable extracting data from Tableau, SQL, and Zendesk to produce accurate weekly and ad-hoc reports.
  • Learn and document our existing Zendesk setup, Slack workflows, and automations.

First Six Months

  • Be recognized as the “go-to” person for data extraction, workflow troubleshooting, and Zendesk admin needs.
  • Independently produce reporting packages and insights that help leadership make decisions.
  • Deliver at least 2–3 workflow or automation improvements that save the team measurable time.
  • Actively document processes and creating clarity around how tools and data are used.
  • Start to contribute ideas for larger process or system enhancements.

First Year

  • Be fully confident operating as the operational backbone of the support organisation while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
  • Anticipate leadership needs by proactively surfacing insights, trends, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Lead small-to-medium operational projects (queue redesign, automation rollouts, feature pilots).
  • Establish clear reporting and automation processes that run smoothly without micromanagement.
  • Be trusted as both a subject matter expert in tools and a partner in shaping how support operates at scale.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 3+ years of experience in operations roles.
  • Intermediate SQL proficiency is required. You should be comfortable writing queries to extract and transform data.
  • Strong proficiency with G Suite tools, especially tools for analysis and reporting.
  • Zendesk admin experience, including managing queues, triggers, macros, and dashboard setup, is a strong advantage.
  • Comfortable extracting data from Tableau.
  • Experience with workflow automation tools, such as Zapier and Slack workflows.
  • Collaborative. Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to build strong, customer-centric relationships, both internally and externally.
  • Team-oriented. Cooperative and promotes an environment of continuous improvement.
  • Problem solver. Must be capable of uncovering issues and resolving them quickly and effectively.
  • Time management. Must be able to work independently and manage multiple priorities without constant supervision.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Note

For Toptal Use Only: #southamerica #easterneurope

End of description

Overview

Job Title: AI Engineer (Search Engine)

About the Company: Insight Global's Client

Type: 10 month extending contract

Compensation: Shared upon initial WhatsApp screening call

Location: Fully Remote

Working Hours: 10AM - 6PM BRT (9AM-5PM EST)

Interview Process: immediate interviews available - 2 rounds can close by end of next week.

Responsibilities

  • Join a small, focused team building backend features for an existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) service.
  • Build and optimize RAG models for search across large-scale medical and scientific documents, including pre-processing and embedding over half a billion documents to ensure they are searchable and contextually accurate.
  • Develop semantic chunking strategies, improve the automated evaluation pipeline, and fine-tune LLMs for textual RAG use cases.
  • Perform hands-on experimentation, model development, and backend engineering, with deployments to non-prod environments and collaboration with DevOps for production rollout.
  • Collaborate with the team to ensure clear updates and effective communication while working as an individual contributor.

Qualifications

  • CLT ONLY (This cannot change to PJ)

  • Needs to be able to start within 2-3 weeks
  • Paid on a monthly basis, no overtime

Must-Haves

  • 1+ years of experience as a Search Engineer or AI Engineer
  • Search Technology Experience – OpenSearch, building scalable search systems
  • 2+ years of Python development experience, including API creation, model training, testing, and general backend programming
  • Familiarity with LangChain for building LLM workflows using tools, memory, and retrieval
  • Strong communication skills – able to work independently while providing clear updates to the team

Nice to Have Skills

  • Familiarity with AWS infrastructure (IAM, VPC, S3, etc.)

Project Overview

We are hiring one AI / LLM Engineer (1 Mid-Level) to join a small, focused team building backend features for an existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) service. Your primary focus will be building and optimizing RAG models for search across large-scale medical and scientific documents, including pre-processing and embedding over half a billion documents to ensure they are searchable and contextually accurate. You’ll work on semantic chunking strategies, improving the automated evaluation pipeline, and fine-tuning LLMs for textual RAG use cases. The role involves hands-on experimentation, model development, and backend engineering, with deployments to non-prod environments and collaboration with DevOps for production rollout. While this is a heads-down, individual contributor role, strong communication and collaboration with the team are essential.

Como UX Designer você irá atuar em cliente de grande porte, com oportunidade de crescimento em frentes diversas na área de dados voltados para o segmento financeiro, impactando áreas críticas como detecção de fraudes e análise de crédito. Esta é a chance de atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e inovador, utilizando tecnologias de ponta para transformar dados em insights valiosos e impactar diretamente os negócios de uma das maiores instituições financeiras do país.

At Aravita, we're not just building a product; we're building the future of AI-enabled fresh food operations. We are a fast-paced, innovative startup on a mission to solve complex problems with data. Our culture is built on collaboration, curiosity, and a passion for technology. We're looking for a brilliant Data Engineer / Cloud Architect to join our dynamic team and help us build a scalable, world-class data infrastructure.

The Role

As a Data Engineer / Cloud Architect, you will be at the heart of our data operations. You'll design, build, and maintain our cutting-edge data platform, empowering our entire organization to make data-driven decisions. This is a hands-on role where you will architect robust data pipelines, optimize our cloud environment, and ensure our data is secure, reliable, and accessible.

  • Designing, developing, and deploying scalable ETL / ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory and PySpark.
  • Architecting and managing our Databricks environment, leveraging Unity Catalog to build a state-of-the-art Lakehouse architecture.
  • Implementing and managing infrastructure on container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
  • Developing monitoring and observability solutions using tools like Grafana to ensure system health and performance.

We\'re looking for a seasoned expert with a passion for building great things. You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and have a strong foundation in data engineering and cloud principles.

Key Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Data Engineer, Cloud Architect, or a similar role.
  • Strong proficiency in building data pipelines with Azure Data Factory and processing large-scale data with PySpark.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with the Databricks platform, including a strong understanding of Unity Catalog and the principles of Lakehouse architecture.
  • Solid experience with containerization and orchestration using Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and visualization tools, specifically Grafana.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.
  • Must currently reside in Brazil. Preference will be given to candidates in the greater São Paulo area to facilitate occasional team meetups.

Why You\'ll Love Working With Us

We believe that our team is our greatest asset, and we invest in our people accordingly. When you join us, you can expect :

  • Competitive Compensation: An attractive salary and benefits package.
  • Remote-First Culture: The flexibility to work from anywhere in Brazil, with the technology and support you need to succeed.
  • Amazing Startup Environment: A vibrant, inclusive, and collaborative culture where your ideas are valued and your impact is real.
  • Growth Opportunities: The chance to grow your skills and career in a rapidly expanding company.
  • Meaningful Work: The opportunity to work on challenging projects that have a direct impact on our business and customers.

If you are a data visionary ready to make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you!

Será responsável por assegurar a viabilidade técnica e produtiva dos projetos dentro da lógica da construção industrializada.

Principais responsabilidades:

  1. Gestão de Projetos Executivos
    • Coordenar o desenvolvimento dos projetos executivos das disciplinas de arquitetura, estruturas, hidráulica, elétrica, fundações, compatibilização, entre outras.
    • Garantir que os projetos estejam aderentes às premissas do produto, aos padrões técnicos da empresa e às normas vigentes.
    • Realizar a compatibilização entre disciplinas visando a redução de retrabalhos e a eficiência construtiva.
    • Assegurar a liberação tempestiva dos projetos conforme os marcos dos cronogramas de produção fabril e execução de obra.
    • Acompanhar o ciclo completo do projeto, desde o anteprojeto até o as built .
  2. Interface com Áreas-Chave
    • Atuar em estreita colaboração com as áreas de Obra, Fábrica, Produto, Suprimentos e Qualidade, promovendo a integração técnica entre os projetos e a execução.
    • Antecipar demandas e riscos junto à obra e à fábrica, propondo soluções de engenharia que atendam às restrições operacionais e produtivas.
    • Suportar tecnicamente a equipe de compras na especificação de materiais e contratação de fornecedores/projetistas terceiros.
    • Participar de comitês de viabilidade técnica de novos produtos ou tipologias, propondo soluções eficientes e padronizadas.
  3. Gestão de Equipes
    • Liderar as equipes internas de projetistas, arquitetos e engenheiros, além de gerenciar os escritórios terceirizados contratados para desenvolvimento de projetos.
    • Distribuir e priorizar demandas entre os times, garantindo alinhamento com os cronogramas e diretrizes corporativas.
    • Estabelecer e acompanhar metas e KPIs de produtividade, qualidade e cumprimento de prazos da equipe de projetos.
    • Promover o desenvolvimento técnico do time, fomentando a cultura de melhoria contínua e inovação.
  4. Processos, Qualidade e Inovação
    • Garantir a aplicação de boas práticas de gestão de projetos e processos de revisão e validação técnica (revisões internas, checklists, validações de obra e fábrica).
    • Manter atualizada a biblioteca de soluções técnicas e boas práticas da empresa, com foco em padronização e escalabilidade.
    • Atuar na melhoria contínua dos processos de desenvolvimento de projetos, buscando eficiência, digitalização e redução de erros.
    • Apoiar a implantação e uso de ferramentas BIM, PLM, bibliotecas paramétricas e outras tecnologias associadas à industrialização da construção.
  5. Relacionamento com a Diretoria
    • Reportar diretamente à Diretoria Técnica e/ou Diretoria de Engenharia.
    • Apresentar relatórios de avanço dos projetos, gargalos, riscos e proposições de melhoria.

Overview

All roles at JumpCloud are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.

About JumpCloud

JumpCloud delivers a unified open directory platform that makes it easy to securely manage identities, devices, and access across your organization. With JumpCloud, IT teams and MSPs enable users to work securely from anywhere and manage their Windows, Apple, Linux, and Android devices from a single platform. JumpCloud is IT Simplified.

Do you enjoy solving challenging problems using the latest technologies within a great team? Is knowing your work will be highly visible and mission critical a key component for the next step in your career? At JumpCloud, we’re looking for the best-in-class talent to help define the future of modern identity and device management from the ground up.

About the Team:

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join an existing product development team. You will have the opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping the success of this team as it delivers customer value across the breadth of our Product.

This unique team’s charter is to allow organizations to integrate any SaaS products where identities can be sourced and where identities and access needs to be managed. Allowing IT admins to manage user identities in a single source and reflect them to any resource an employee needs access.

What you will be doing:

  • Develop and maintain high-quality web applications using C# and the .NET Core.
  • Build rich, responsive user interfaces with Angular and TypeScript.
  • Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable APIs.
  • Collaborate with other engineers, designers, and product managers to define, design, and ship new features.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code following software development best practices.
  • Participate in the entire software development lifecycle, from concept to deployment.
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues and ensure the performance and scalability of our applications.
  • Help the team and organization live by our core values: building connections, thinking big and getting 1% better every day.

You have:

  • A minimum of 3+ years of professional software development experience with a focus on C#, including solid knowledge of .NET Core.
  • A minimum of 3+ years of front-end development experience using Angular (v2 or higher) and TypeScript.
  • Experience creating unit tests using frameworks such as xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest.
  • Strong experience developing RESTful APIs.
  • Deep understanding of object-oriented programming, SOLID principles, and design patterns.
  • Experience with relational SQL Server and NoSQL (MongoDB) databases.
  • Proficiency with version control tools, such as Git.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

#LI-PD1

Where you’ll be working/Location:

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

Language:

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Why JumpCloud?

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud. Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Scam Notice:

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at with the subject line "Scam Notice"

Leverage Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) to provision and manage monitoring tools, alerting rules, and our observability configurations across OTEL Pipelines.

Exposure with OpenTelemetry Pipelines.

title: Principal Product Manager - PIX
description:
Company Description


Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.

More about our mission and what we offer .
*Resumes must be submitted in English to be considered.*


Job Description


As our Principal Product Manager, you will be responsible for defining the vision for PIX, enhancing our infrastructure to make international transfers feel as seamless as local payments, and driving growth by identifying new opportunities within the PIX ecosystem.

This role will give you the opportunity to:

  • Choose your path to impact. We believe people are most empowered when they can act autonomously. So rather than telling you what to do, you’ll work with your team to create a vision of your own. Of course, you can always gather feedback from smart, curious people across Wise but you’ll have the freedom to make your own calls while being accountable for your decisions.

  • Build money without borders for LatAm & MEA. You will be building a product that helps millions of businesses and customers send and receive money from their friends, family and partners to and from LatAm & MEA.

  • Be on the forefront of solving a complex technical challenge. Wise is probably the only company integrated into payment systems of so many countries around the world, and the number will keep on growing. Scaling this infrastructure is a problem very few, if anyone, have solved before. You will be at the forefront of this problem, allowing you to flex your creative muscles to solve global money movement for our customers once and for all. You would most likely end up setting best practices not just for Wise but the industry at large.


Qualifications


What we are looking for:

  • You have a proven track record in the payments space, specifically with PIX, and deeply understand its operational processes, risk management, and vendor landscape.

  • You possess the technical depth to understand system architecture and engage in detailed, credible discussions with engineers.

  • You excel at breaking down complex, ambiguous problems into logical, structured components and can articulate their importance to the bigger picture.

  • You have a bias for action and are hands-on, with clear evidence of diving into analytics, speaking to customers, or writing your own queries to drive projects forward.

  • You demonstrate the ability to lead without direct authority, effectively aligning teams with conflicting priorities and leveraging expertise from other functions to reach a consensus.

  • You have experience working in an agile setup within a fintech environment.

  • Bonus points if you are comfortable analyzing large datasets independently and have experience mentoring junior Product Managers.

  • You speak fluent English.


Additional Information


What we offer:

  • RSU's in a rapidly growing company

  • An annual self-development budget

  • Flexible working model

  • Medical and dental insurance for you and direct dependants

  • Meal voucher (Caju)

  • 3 "me days" of PTO

  • Totalpass

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

We realized a new perimeter was needed, one that is built in the cloud and follows and protects data wherever it goes, so we started Netskope to redefine Cloud, Network and Data Security.

Netskope Cloud Data Plane engineers architect and design one of the most scalable, high-performance cloud data planes in the world, processing 10+ Gbps of traffic, performing deep inspection using state-of-the-art techniques like AI/ML to detect activities and apply advanced policies like DLP, Threat and UEBA protection, all at line rate.

Join to apply for the Ubuntu Core Software Engineer role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Ubuntu Core Software Engineer to redefine the Linux experience in embedded environments with the smallest, most secure, and updatable operating system in the IoT market. This is an opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, security, and the developer experience. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill with low-level operating systems, kernel, and device firmware.

Our mission is to allow everyone to build robust solutions in various fields including but not limited to IoT, automotive, and aviation using the next generation secure embedded Linux operating system in a simple solution. We define a reliable and secure set of device recovery mechanisms that enable device manufacturers to simplify and standardise the field operations for fleets of heterogeneous appliances.

As an Ubuntu Core team member, you'll be designing and implementing software that runs on various CPU architectures, such as ARM, RISC-V, and X86. You will work on boot mechanisms, bootloaders, storage partition layout, device trees, kernel and services.

Build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company.

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Review code produced by other engineers

  • Integrate diverse bootloaders and maintain gadget snaps
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 times a year for internal and external events

    • Linux security implementations - TPM, FDE, LUKS, HSM, etc.

Overview

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to lead front-end initiatives for Agoda. What you’ll do

What you’ll need to succeed

  • Hands-on experience owning production services with impact on design, development, deployment, monitoring, and evolution
  • Curiosity and staying on the cutting edge of technology and open source
  • Advanced proficiency in modern JavaScript frameworks and state management
  • Deep understanding of cross-platform development challenges and solutions
  • Extensive experience with Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) patterns and micro-frontend architecture
  • Expert-level knowledge of front-end testing methodologies, tools, and best practices

Desenvolvedor (a) Frontend React Senior

Modelo de trabalho : Remoto

Horário : Segunda-feira à Sexta-feira, 9h00 às 18h00h

Sobre a Motivus

Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Diferenciais

  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento frontend.

  • Perfil autônomo, proativo e orientado a resultados .

Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?

  • Desenvolva sua Carreira : Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes : Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo : Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente : Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.

Nossos Valores

  • Cultura de Inovação : Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade : Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Your work on Identity Management will directly impact the users of all Canonical products. In addition, you will help write Juju charms to manage operational concerns.
Technical excellence and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to own the design and delivery of the system, facilitate integrations and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA and AMER regions.
The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Go (Golang) and optionally Python
  • Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Create and enhance management, authentication and authorization API endpoints
  • Craft end-user authentication flows from design to implementation
  • Write Juju charms (operators) to manage operational concerns
  • Modernize the identity stack of our websites and products by driving adoption of best-of-breed IAM technologies
  • Deliver great products that users love by maintaining a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You are a software engineer, with specific experience building identity and access management products
  • You are familiar with the open source software, standards, protocols and concepts in the identity space (e.g. OpenID, OAuth, LDAP)
  • You have experience implementing authorization frameworks in distributed systems
  • You value secure coding and standards, and enjoy working on teams that do the same
  • You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform
In addition:
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. title: SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER NODE
description:
Overview

O Ton é uma empresa do grupo Stone Co., focada em empoderar empreendedores autônomos por meio de soluções financeiras como maquininhas, conta digital, cartão e programa de renda extra. Nosso time é apaixonado por desafios e movido por impacto real na vida dos nossos clientes — sempre com leveza, autonomia e muita colaboração. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar com um time de apaixonados por desafios, sempre preocupado em atender da melhor forma os nossos clientes e buscando as melhores escolhas técnicas para entregar os resultados. E mais importante, tudo isso em um ambiente descontraído com horário flexível e a possibilidade de trabalhar remoto.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

A equipe do programa Renda Extra | TON está dedicada a transformar vidas por meio de oportunidades únicas de geração de renda. Nosso programa oferece uma maneira inovadora para os nossos parceiros, de obter uma renda adicional ou até mesmo substituir sua fonte de renda principal sem nenhum vínculo empregatício. Nosso objetivo é empoderar as pessoas, proporcionando-lhes os meios para alcançar a estabilidade financeira e crescimento pessoal.

Senior Software Engineer Node

Você terá um papel essencial na evolução do nosso ecossistema, atuando no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, provas de conceito e melhorias contínuas nos nossos microsserviços e aplicações. Esperamos que você contribua ativamente desde a ideação até a entrega, participando de cerimônias, revisando código, mantendo e atualizando a documentação técnica. Fará parte de um time colaborativo, engajado em criar soluções escaláveis e de alto impacto, sempre em alinhamento com os padrões técnicos da companhia. Aqui, valorizamos opiniões, ideias novas e iniciativas — queremos que você protagonize melhorias e ajude a elevar a barra técnica do produto. Também é esperado que você compartilhe conhecimento com o time, lidere refatorações quando necessário, e participe ativamente do refinamento de demandas junto ao time de UX, garantindo entregas com qualidade e foco no cliente.

O que esperamos de você

  • Experiência com NodeJS, TypeScript e Jest
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura moderna: SOLID, Clean Architecture, FaaS, APIs REST/WebSocket
  • Prática com AWS (Lambda, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, S3 etc.) e banco NoSQL (DynamoDB)
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de cache e busca (Redis, OpenSearch/ElasticSearch)
  • Git, CI/CD, documentação técnica e segurança em desenvolvimento

O que aumenta as suas chances

  • Experiência Banco de Dados relacional
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de infraestrutura em código, como Terraform
  • Habilidade de otimização para suporte de alto volume de dados
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento como DataDog, CloudWatch e Splunk
  • Experiência com automação de Testes e testes de carga (Jest, K6, JMeter)

Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Hospital Digital, da Vitta: com equipe médica 24/7
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação
  • Auxílio Remoto + Setup Inicial (para vagas remotas)
  • Horário flexível
  • Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com livros, podcasts, treinamentos e videoaulas
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Vale Transporte (exclusivo para vagas presenciais)

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  1. Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco. Nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve.
  2. Entrevistas com o time de People: papo para conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio proposto.
  3. Avaliação Técnica: aprofundar hard skills com possibility de dois papos ou um desafio.
  4. Check de Cultura: conversa com guardiões da cultura para alinhar crenças e visão.
  5. Feedback: compartilharemos o feedback independente do resultado.
  6. E aí? Curtiu? Inscreva-se e #VemSerStone

title: B2B Analytics Senior Manager
description:
Overview

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub! We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a B2B Analytics Senior Manager to our Marketing Operations team in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

The B2B Insights Senior Manager will join our global Marketing Operations team, with a primary focus on the US B2B market. In this role, you will be responsible for generating strategic insights that shape our global approach while also delivering deep, localized analysis to accelerate growth in the US. You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders across marketing, sales, and operations, translating complex data into clear business narratives that drive decision-making. This is a great opportunity for a senior professional who combines strategic vision with hands-on analytical expertise, bringing a consultative mindset to help Wellhub strengthen its data-driven marketing capabilities and expand its impact in the B2B space.

Your Impact

  • Accelerate US Growth: Accelerates growth in the US by providing granular, market-specific insights, enabling the US marketing team to make smarter, faster decisions, improving campaign performance, lead generation, and revenue contribution. You will serve as the dedicated data partner for the US revenue marketing team, uncovering deep, localized insights from granular data to drive targeted initiatives and inform strategic decisions for this key market. The role involves navigating the pressures of the US market and coordinating with marketing, sales operations, and sales.
  • Drive Global Strategy: Analyzes macro-level trends and performance benchmarks that inform and optimize our global marketing strategy, leading to more efficient spending and a stronger market position.
  • Data & Reporting: Collects and analyzes data from sources such as data lake, HubSpot, Salesforce, Web Analytics, Paid Media, etc., to produce analyses for global and US needs. Ensures accurate tracking of key marketing KPIs (Traffic, MQLs, Conversion Rates, etc.) and translates complex data into reports and presentations for stakeholders.
  • Innovation: Identifies, evaluates, and advocates for AI-powered tools and innovative solutions to improve data analysis and understanding of the B2B ecosystem.
  • Live the mission: Inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

Who You Are

  • Academic Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Analytics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • Data & Analytics Expertise: Strong foundation in data analysis, including statistical analysis, A/B testing methodologies, and attribution modeling.
  • B2B Marketing Acumen: Understanding of the B2B lead-to-revenue funnel, including metrics, lead scoring, and customer lifecycle stages.
  • Technical Proficiency:
    • Experience with Marketing Automation platforms like HubSpot and Marketo
    • Experience with CRM like Salesforce
    • Proficiency in BI tools like Tableau or Looker
    • Proficiency in data manipulation languages like SQL and Python is a plus
  • Professional Experience:
    • Previous senior-level experience in a marketing analytics, business intelligence, or marketing operations role
    • B2B experience is mandatory, but not specific in marketing
    • International experience is a plus
  • Languages: Fluent English is mandatory
  • Fit with Wellhub: Alignment with the culture of well-being and work-life balance

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don’t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, proven experience in B2B analytics/insights and hands-on expertise with marketing technology and CRM tools are mandatory requirements.

What We Offer You (LatAm)

We are a wellness company committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize benefits according to your needs.

  • WELLHUB: Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. The Gold plan is provided at no cost, with other premium plans available at a significant discount.
  • WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.
  • FLEXIBLE WORK: Flexible First company with two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote. Office for collaboration, home office stipend, and monthly flexible work allowance.
  • FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility to adjust working hours based on personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.
  • PAID TIME OFF: Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year plus 1 day per year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) plus a birthday off.
  • PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: 100% paid parental leave for new parents and extended maternity leave.
  • CAREER GROWTH: Opportunities for personal and career growth with a growth mindset and investment in development.
  • CULTURE: Supportive, international environment with global collaboration; invites you to learn more on our careers page.

Additional: Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn for a glimpse of life at Wellhub.

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub: Wellhub is committed to a diverse, workplace where everyone belongs. We are an equal opportunity employer and include diverse applicants regardless of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!

Sobre a vaga:

  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para definir, projetar e lançar novos recursos;
  • Elaborar e conduzir refinamentos técnicos de demandas trazidas pelo time de produtos; Atuar na manutenção da saúde e qualidade do codebase, equilibrando novas funcionalidades com resolução de débitos técnicos;
  • Desenvolver soluções escaláveis e que irão ser utilizadas por milhões de usuários;
  • Ser crítico em relação a Monitoria e Observabilidade;
  • Atuar na manutenção dos testes automatizados, incluindo criação de novos;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade e auxiliar no desenvolvimento destes;
  • Elaboração de documentação técnica de novas funcionalidades;
  • Participar das cerimônias junto com os demais integrantes da equipe.

Requisitos:

  • experiência sólida com Java 17+, Spring Boot e Hibernate;
  • Experiência com Node.js e NestJS;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (SQL e NoSQL), incluindo: Oracle, MongoDB e AWS RDS
  • Experiência com mensageria (RabbitMQ, SQS);
  • Vivência em arquitetura de microsserviços;
  • Experiência no design e consumo de APIs REST;
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados, incluindo: Testes unitários (JUnit 5) e Testes de contrato (Pact)
  • Experiência com Axway API Gateway;
  • Vivência com Git e versionamento de código;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento (ex.: Dynatrace);
  • Conhecimento de Clean Code, Clean Architecture e modularização;
  • Adoção de boas práticas de código, documentação e desenvolvimento de componentes;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicações mobile e front-end com React Native e React;
  • Vivência com Next.js, React Hooks, Styled Components e Axios;
  • Experiência em arquitetura de Microfrontends (MFE).

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

title: Chamada para seleção de propostas pesquisa científica: Desmatamento e sistemas alimentares no Brasil
description:
Chamada para seleção de propostas pesquisa científica: Desmatamento e sistemas alimentares no Brasil

Sobre a oportunidade

1. INTRODUÇÃO E CONTEXTO
A ProVeg Brasil é uma organização dedicada à transformação do sistema alimentar global, visando um futuro mais sustentável para todos, por meio do incentivo de dietas baseadas em vegetais. Reconhecemos a urgência e a complexidade dos desafios ambientais que o Brasil enfrenta, especialmente no que tange ao desmatamento e suas interconexões com os sistemas de produção e consumo de produtos de origem animal.
O Brasil assumiu o compromisso de alcançar o desmatamento zero até 2030, uma meta fundamental para a conservação de biomas de importância global, como a Amazônia e o Cerrado, e para o cumprimento de suas obrigações climáticas internacionais. Neste cenário, a agropecuária é amplamente reconhecida como um dos principais vetores de mudança no uso da terra no país.
Diante da relevância estratégica deste tema, a ProVeg Brasil busca subsidiar suas ações de advocacy e formulação de políticas públicas com evidências científicas robustas.
IMPORTANTE: ESTA NÃO É UMA VAGA DE EMPREGO. EM VEZ DE SE CANDIDATAR ATRAVÉS DO NOSSO SITE, ENVIE SUA PROPOSTA PARA , CONFORME EXPLICADO NA PARTE INFERIOR DESTA PÁGINA.

Detalhes da posição

2. OBJETIVO GERAL
Selecionar a elaboração de uma pesquisa científica para investigar a relação entre o desmatamento no Brasil e os sistemas de produção e consumo de produtos de origem animal, buscando compreender os desafios e as possibilidades para o alcance das metas de desmatamento zero no país.

Responsabilidades

3. ESCOPO DA PESQUISA / TEMAS DE INTERESSE
A pesquisa deverá abordar, de forma abrangente e crítica, os seguintes temas interligados:

  • Desmatamento e Pecuária: Análise da dinâmica e dos impactos da expansão da pecuária (bovina, suína, avícola e outras) e de monoculturas destinadas à alimentação animal sobre o desmatamento em biomas brasileiros, com especial atenção à Amazônia e ao Cerrado.
  • Cadeias de Suprimentos de Produtos de Origem Animal: Investigação do papel de todos os produtos de origem animal e de seus insumos (como a produção de grãos para ração animal, a exemplo da soja) na pressão sobre as florestas e vegetação nativa.
  • Avaliação de Soluções e Limitações: Exame aprofundado do alcance e das limitações de soluções propostas para a sustentabilidade da produção, como a pecuária regenerativa e a intensificação da produção, em relação às metas de desmatamento e à mitigação de emissões de gases de efeito estufa (incluindo o metano).
  • Padrões de Consumo e Produção: Análise dos níveis atuais de produção e consumo de produtos de origem animal no Brasil, considerando tanto o mercado interno quanto as exportações, e suas implicações para o cenário de desmatamento. O estudo deverá explorar cenários e quantificar as transformações necessárias para o alcance das metas de desmatamento zero.

Requisitos

4. RESULTADOS ESPERADOS / ENTREGAS
O trabalho contratado deverá resultar em:

  • Estudo Científico Detalhado: Um relatório de pesquisa completo, com metodologia clara, análise de dados e conclusões embasadas cientificamente. Espera-se que a versão final deste estudo tenha aproximadamente 25-30 páginas.
  • Policy Brief: Um documento conciso e direto, com recomendações estratégicas para guiar as ações de advocacy político da ProVeg Brasil junto a formuladores de políticas, setor privado e sociedade civil.
